messages.templateSet: Marked as template. It can now be applied when creating profiles.

messages.cacheFreedPartial: Freed {size}; {skipped} profile(s) skipped because they are running

form.name: Profile Name
form.forwardPortTip: Forward CDP to 0.0.0.0 to allow LAN/WAN access
form.disableExtensionsTip: Add --disable-extensions flag on launch. Turn off to load installed extensions
form.debuggerModeTip: Add --remote-debugging-port on launch for automation, debugging & performance monitoring
form.debugPortConfigTip: Chrome remote debugging port (CDP). Leave empty to auto-allocate a free port
form.templateTip: Use "Set as Template" in a card's menu to make any profile reusable when creating new ones.
form.launchArgsTip: Per-profile Chrome CLI flags (proxy, user agent, window size...). Leave empty to skip.
form.extraArgsTip: Split by whitespace and passed to the browser as-is. Do not add unsafe flags.
form.templateModeExtensionsTip: Copies extension files, extension settings, userscript storage and Preferences. Cookies and site data are not copied.
form.templateModeFullTip: Copies everything except caches, including login state, cookies and bookmarks (no longer isolated).
